events.name: Old Wanderer
dialogue: The road to town lies through the gate in the south-east corner.
Watch out for wolves after dusk...
They say a hidden path west of here winds up to an old shrine. I'd not go looking for it, if I were you.

events.name: Corrupted Shrine Warden
introLines: A pulse of black light rises from the shrine altar!
The Corrupted Shrine Warden blocks your path, its form seething with the Blight.
clearedLines: The altar glows with a faint, clean light. The corruption here has receded.
